title: A Smile for the Harvest
author: Coral Lockridge
blurb: Bram Lockridge, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
